new_rules.topic: what to do after a success
new_rules.text: After a full success, repeat the exact same three steps in the same order

new_rules.topic: what to pass on to the young
new_rules.text: Let the young fail twice on their own before you show them the order.
Exile any partner who takes the harvest without sharing it, after two such takings.
Trust a partner's advice only after their step order has worked on a plant

new_rules.topic: what to pass on to the young
new_rules.text: Teach the young the order first: soak, then pound, roast, and dry last.

new_rules.topic: which action should or should not come first
new_rules.text: Always soak first; never roast before soaking, even if pounding seems ready.
